items.raw_excerpt: Cyberabad Traffic Police impose 60-day traffic diversions near Khajaguda Junction for water pipelines, guiding three detours around Nanakramguda and IT corridor.
items.summary_en: Cyberabad police will close some roads near Khajaguda Junction for 60 days. The work is to lay new water pipelines. Drivers are asked to use three other roads around Nanakramguda and the main tech corridor instead.
items.summary_ko: 사이버가바드 경찰은 카자가우다 교차로 주변 도로를 60일간 통행 제한한다. 새 수도관을 놓기 위한 조치다. 경찰은 나나크람구다와 정보기술 도로 구간을 이용하는 우회로 세 곳을 안내했다.
items.title_en: Road Closures Near Khajaguda Junction for 60 Days; Police Offer Three Detour Routes

items.title_original: Khajaguda junction restrictions may push traffic onto internal roads; Cyberabad Police map three alternative routes

items.raw_excerpt: With AI, economic shifts and a tightening job market making traditional roles feel less secure, many internationals are looking for a fresh start. We spoke to an expert about how to successfully switch careers in Germany.
items.summary_en: An expert says people should stay curious when they want to change careers in Germany. Many foreign workers look for a new start as AI and a tighter job market change the work market.
items.summary_ko: 직업을 바꾸려는 사람들에게 호기심을 유지하라고 조언한 전문가가 있다. AI와 Occupy 좁아지는 노동시장으로 외국인 노동자들이 새 출발을 찾는 Vinext가 늘고 있다.
items.title_en: Expert Gives Job Change Advice in Germany
items.title_ko: 독일 직업 전환 조언, 전문가의 핵심은 '호기심'

items.raw_excerpt: There are plenty of fantastic festivals taking place across France in October, from jazz and electronic music to wine and food. Here are seven to get in your diary and there's something for almost everyone's taste.
items.summary_en: Many small festivals run across France in October. They cover jazz, electronic music, wine, and food. We picked seven good ones for your calendar, and there is one for almost everyone.

items.raw_excerpt: Tessa Virtue, the three-time Olympic champion ice dancer, will make her stage debut — without skates — in a new solo contemporary dance performance at the Fall For Dance North Festival in Toronto.
items.summary_en: Tessa Virtue, a three-time Olympic champion in ice dancing, will star in a new solo dance show. She performs it at the Fall For Dance North Festival in Toronto. She says dancing without skates feels terrifying and invigorating at the same time.
items.summary_ko: 얼음댄싱에서 올림픽 금메달을 세 번 얻은 테사 버츄가 새 솔로 공연을 한다. 공연은 캐나다 토론토의 폴 포 댄스 노스 페스티벌에서 열린다. 스케이트를 신지 않고 춤추는 것이 무섭지만 동시에 활력을 준다고 말한다.

items.raw_excerpt: Keep up to date with all of the latest developments as residents remain on the Garvaghy Road on the third day of the Drumcree dispute.
items.summary_en: The government mediator in the Drumcree dispute says he thinks there will be a decision on the Orangemen parade. Residents on Garvaghy Road stayed on the road on the third day. The dispute is about whether the parade will pass the Orange Order area.

items.raw_excerpt: Central Tokyo on Tuesday registered 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest streak on record, according to the weather agency. The area has seen precipitation since Aug 27, with approaching typhoons, a stalled autumn rain front and a trough of low pressure contributing to the rain. The previous record…
items.summary_en: Central Tokyo had rain for 34 days in a row. This is the longest rain streak ever recorded there. Rain since late August, two typhoons, and a stuck autumn rain front all added to it.
items.summary_ko: 도쿄 한복판에 34일 연속으로 비가 왔습니다. 역대 최장 기록입니다. 8월 말부터 계속된 비에 typhoon과 정체된 가을 비 fronts가 겹쳐 한 waterspout 기록이 이어졌습니다.
items.title_en: Central Tokyo has rain for 34 days in a row, the longest ever

items.title_original: Central Tokyo records 34 consecutive days of rain; longest on record

items.raw_excerpt: In a social media post on Monday (Sep 28), Luna said it will close its doors on Dec 31.
items.summary_en: The popular patisserie Luna will close its doors on Dec 31. The owner announced this on social media on Sep 28. The shop blames rising costs for the closing.

items.summary_en: The ferry IONIS had a mechanical problem near the island of Kea and was not allowed to leave port. Workers fixed the broken machinery. The sailing ban was then lifted, so the ship can travel from Kea to Lavrio again.

items.raw_excerpt: There is perhaps no better example of an independent business than the neighborhood used bookstore. But like many such businesses these days, it can be really hard to make ends meet as they compete with cheaper chain stores or faster and more convenient electronic alternatives. So at first, it must…
items.summary_en: Used book shops in Japan are selling huge piles of old books to one mystery buyer. Small shops say they cannot match the prices this buyer offers. No one knows who is placing the big orders.
items.summary_ko: 일본 중고책집에 정체불명의 손님이 책 더미를 통째로 사 간다. 작은 서점들은 그 손님이 내놓는 값에 맞출 수 없다고 말한다. 그렇게 대량으로 주문하는 사람이 누구인지는 아무도 모른다.

items.raw_excerpt: The same midwife and medical student were also present at both sisters' deliveries at the maternity hospital in Turku.
items.summary_en: Two sisters gave birth on the same day at a maternity hospital in Turku. The same midwife and the same medical student helped at both births. Hospital staff called it a rare double delivery.
items.summary_ko: 자매 두 사람이 같은 날 투르쿠의 한 산부인과 병원에서 아기를 낳았다. 두 출산 모두 같은 산모와 같은 의대생이 보조했다. 병원은 이 일을 드문 이중 출산이라고 말했다.
items.title_en: Turku Twin Sisters Give Birth on the Same Day
items.title_ko: 투르쿠 쌍둥이 자매, 같은 날 출산

items.raw_excerpt: Loh's silver is the best result by a Singaporean badminton player at the Asian Games.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Loh Kean Yew lost to Thailand's Kunlavut Vitidsarn in the men's singles final at the Asian Games. This is the best result any Singaporean badminton player has reached at the Games. Loh ends his campaign with a silver medal.
items.summary_ko: 룽 칸위가 태국의 쿤라부트 비디산과 아시아선 남자 배드민턴 결승에서 졌다. 싱가포르 선수로는 아시아선 역대 최고 성적이다. 룽 칸위는 은메달로 이번 대회를 마무리했다.
items.title_en: Loh Kean Yew wins Asian Games silver after losing the final
items.title_ko: 룽 칸위, 아시아선 결승 패배하고 은메달 획득
items.title_original: Loh Kean Yew falls to Kunlavut Vitidsarn in Asian Games final, ends campaign with silver

items.raw_excerpt: Icelandair is ending its Halifax service on October 18 and does not plan to restore the route next summer.
items.summary_en: Icelandair will stop its flights between Iceland and Halifax on October 18. The airline says it does not plan to bring the route back next summer. Halifax travellers will need to book another airline or a connecting flight.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드항공이 10월 18일부터 아이슬란드와 캐나다 할리팍스를 오가는 노선을 끝낸다. 회사는 내년 여름에도 이 노선을 되살릴 계획이 없다고 밝혔다. 할리팍스 승객들은 다른 항공편이나 경유편으로 대신 이동해야 한다.
items.title_en: Icelandair to End Halifax Flights on October 18

items.title_original: Icelandair to End Halifax Flights in October

items.raw_excerpt: A Vietnamese high school student in the northern province of Lang Son won the Asian championship and placed among the world's top three at the Chinese Bridge competition.
items.summary_en: A high school student from Lang Son Province in northern Vietnam won the Asian championship at a Chinese language contest in China. She also placed in the world's top three in the same contest.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 라응선성 고등학생이 중국에서 열린 중국어 말하기 대회에서 아시아 챔피언을 거뒀다. 같은 대회에서 세계3위에도 들었다.

items.raw_excerpt: The summer is drawing to a close. With that in mind, now is a good time to roll out some common Swedish autumn topics and phrases to help you navigate your way through the darker days.
items.summary_en: Summer is ending in Sweden, and the days will soon get darker. Here are six common Swedish words and phrases about autumn. Learning them can help you enjoy the darker, cooler months.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴은 여름이 저물고 곧 날이 어두워집니다. 가을에 자주 쓰는 스웨덴 단어와 표현 여섯 가지를 소개합니다. 이 표현들을 알면 스웨덴의 어두운 계절을 더 편하게 보낼 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Six keys to understanding autumn in Sweden
items.title_ko: 스웨덴 가을, 알아두면 좋은 여섯 가지

items.raw_excerpt: Ação, que reconhece mestres da cultura, investirá R$ 5 milhões em projetos. Cada instituição federal de Ensino Superior poderá apresentar apenas uma proposta.
items.summary_en: Brazil's federal agencies will put 5 million reais into projects that bring traditional community knowledge into universities. Each public university can send only one proposal. The program recognizes culture masters who hold old skills and teachings.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 연방 기관은 전통 지식을 대학 교육에 접목하는 프로젝트에 500만 레알을 투자한다. 각 연방 고등교육 기관은 제안서 한 건만 제출할 수 있다. 전통 문화의 장인들이 가진 지혜와 경험을 대학 교육에 반영하는 자리다.
items.title_en: Brazil Opens Grants for Traditional Knowledge in Higher Education
items.title_ko: 전통 지식과 대학 교육을 잇는 지원 공고
items.title_original: Edital abre inscrição para unir saberes tradicionais e ensino superior

items.raw_excerpt: A powerloom weaver from Karur district in Tamil Nadu has created a Thirukkural book made of woven cotton fabric
items.summary_en: A powerloom weaver from Karur district in Tamil Nadu made a book of the Thirukkural. He wove 133 pages from cotton fabric. The ancient Tamil poems now exist as cloth instead of paper.
items.summary_ko: 타밀나두 카루르 지명의 파워룸 직조공이 티루쿠랄을 천으로 짜 하나의 책을 만들었습니다. 총 133쪽에 걸쳐 코튼 천으로 직조했다고 합니다. 오랜_contents의 고대 타밀 시집이 종이 대신 천으로현존하게 됐습니다.
items.title_en: Weaver Makes a 133-Page Book Out of Cotton Cloth
items.title_ko: 진짜 책이 아니라 천으로 뜬 티루쿠랄 133쪽 책
items.title_original: Thirukkural woven in cotton: Karur weaver creates 133-page fabric book

items.raw_excerpt: Anyone who has just moved to a new country knows the particular quiet of a first Saturday afternoon with no one to call. The shops are open, the sun is out, and the calendar is completely empty. For the foreign residents who settle in Portugal every year, that empty calendar is the real adjustment, more than the paperwork or the property search ever was.
items.summary_en: Many foreigners move to Portugal every year. At first they know no one, and the empty days feel lonely. Local groups, sports clubs, and shared hobbies help them build a social life from zero.
items.summary_ko: 포르투발에는 매년 많은 외국인들이 새로 이민 온다. 처음에는 친구가 없고 할 일도 없어 외롭게 느껴진다. 동호회와 운동 클럽 같은 모임이 이들에게 친구와 하루길을 만들어 준다.
items.title_en: How New Expats in Portugal Make Friends
items.title_ko: 포르투발로 온 외국인들, 처음부터 친구 사 만들기
items.title_original: How Expats in Portugal Build a Social Life From Zero

items.summary_en: Swedish businesses expect to raise prices more than usual this year. This comes from a monthly economic survey by the National Institute of Economic Research. Higher prices may hit food and other everyday items.

items.raw_excerpt: Last year, mainland Portugal recorded a safe tap water indicator of nearly 100%, marking the 11th consecutive year this has occurred, according to data released today by the Water and Waste Services Regulation Authority (ERSAR).
items.summary_en: Tap water in mainland Portugal was safe almost 100% of the time last year. This is the 11th year in a row with such a good result, the water regulator ERSAR says.

items.title_en: Portugal tap water is nearly 100% safe
